scope: Local ARM64 representative-fixture worker audit, frozen bulk plus explicitly separated narrow code deltas; not universal format/content support or production AMD64 certification

media.validation: Real worker output, exact muxer brand, explicit MPEG4/AAC codec inspection, successful first-second decode; representative fixtures only

limits: FFmetadata, Markdown and Beamer are bounded UTF-8/structural text checks, not render or TeX execution.
3MF checks bounded ZIP, OPC relationships/content type, model/mesh/build XML and indices; it is not complete 3MF conformance or geometry fidelity.
X3DB HelloWorld input produces a geometrically empty 3MF and remains rejected.
No historical bulk result has been relabelled with this newer validator revision.
FFMETA fixtures extract container metadata only; they do not preserve input media/subtitle payload.

limitations: One or several known fixtures are not every variant or file; output validation is not full content fidelity.
462 declared input identifiers have no current specimen and have not been runtime certified.
The unchanged paths retain frozen bulk evidence; changed alpha, media and font branches have separate targeted regressions.
Failed fixtures are not automatically unsupported formats; invalid/incomplete specimens and engine limits require triage.
Raw declarations and sitemap inclusion do not prove conversion success or search indexing.
FFMETA extraction cases preserve container metadata only, not source media or subtitle content.
